tex_content.html:
\begin{claim} \end{claim}[$y$ lies in the parabolic neighborhood of $z$] $y\in \widetilde P(z,\delta _2',\delta '_2)$. \end{claim}

Proof

\sketch By construction $|t'-t_0|<\delta \le \delta _2'$. Also, $d_{t_0}(y,b)<\delta \le \delta '_2/2$. Since $d_{t_0}\le 2d_{t'}$, we have $d_{t'}(y,b)< \delta '_2$ the claim is then immediate.

□
